table.ruleA: 6 compartments, volume/inception/desinence/start = (10,7,3,3),(8,6,2,6),(12,9,4,6),(6,5,2,2),(9,7,3,2),(7,5,2,1); limit 38; all LAMINAR; overboard 0; quarter/half rounded down
table.ruleB: 6 stages, rated/upper/lower/start identical numbers; limit 38; all CLEAR; ground 0; quarter/half rounded down

table.ruleA: Add the cycle's fill amount to each compartment; volume not enforced
table.ruleB: Add the cycle's input to each stage; rated charge not enforced

table.ruleA: Sequential 1..6; if contents > volume, excess goes to n+1 (already present when n+1 is checked), contents set to volume; excess from 6 overboard; equal does nothing
table.ruleB: Sequential 1..6; if charge > rated, excess to n+1 (cascades), set to rated; excess from 6 to ground; equal does nothing

table.ruleA: Read contents after Step 2. LAMINAR -> CAVITATING only if contents ABOVE (strictly >) inception mark; CAVITATING -> LAMINAR if contents at most desinence; contents equal to inception keeps state
table.ruleB: Read charge after Step 2. CLEAR -> ASSERTED if charge AT LEAST (>=) upper mark; ASSERTED -> CLEAR if charge at most lower mark; only charge strictly between lower and upper keeps state
table.difference: Rising threshold differs: A requires contents > inception mark, B requires charge >= upper mark. At exactly the mark A stays LAMINAR while B goes ASSERTED. (A's definition line 'Cavitation begins at the inception mark' is loose wording; the operative Step 3 rule and its 'at or below inception keeps state' sentence fix it as strict.) Falling threshold (<= lower) is the same.

table.ruleA: Simultaneous: amounts computed from contents at start of step using post-Step-3 state; LAMINAR quarter rounded down to overboard; CAVITATING half rounded down to n-1, compartment 1's to overboard; volume not enforced
table.ruleB: Simultaneous: CLEAR quarter rounded down to ground; ASSERTED half rounded down to n-1, stage 1's to ground; rated not enforced

table.ruleA: If total of all six > 38 (strict), every compartment halved rounded down (keep floor half), removed units overboard; log cycle; equal 38 does nothing
table.ruleB: If total > 38 strictly, every stage halved rounded down, removed to ground; log cycle; 38 does nothing

table.ruleA: (a) end contents (b) end states (c) state changes (cycle, compartment, before, after) (d) blow cycles or none (e) Total Overboard (f) balance check
table.ruleB: (a) end charges (b) end states (c) state changes in order (d) trip cycles or never (e) ground total (f) balance check with four figures

result.probeWhy: Every position starts exactly on its rising mark (inception/upper), with zero input, so at the cycle-1 state check A's strict 'above' leaves all six LAMINAR while B's 'at least' asserts all six; nothing else (overflow, blow) interferes, isolating the suspected threshold difference.
